fields.label: Date (display text)
fields.name: event_date_text
fields.instructions: Leave blank to generate from Event start.

fields.label: Page layout
fields.name: page_layout
fields.instructions: On phones the details always sit above the form.

fields.label: About this event
fields.name: summary
fields.instructions: Short description shown beside the form (optional).

fields.label: Form fields
fields.name: form_fields
fields.instructions: Drag to reorder. Use the width setting to place fields side-by-side.

sub_fields.label: Field key
sub_fields.name: name
sub_fields.instructions: Auto from label. Used in exports, emails ({key}) and conditions.

sub_fields.label: Saved list
sub_fields.name: preset
sub_fields.instructions: Manage lists in Event Plus → Settings.

sub_fields.label: Must be unique per event
sub_fields.name: unique
sub_fields.instructions: Blocks duplicate registrations (e.g. same email or NRIC).

sub_fields.label: Content
sub_fields.name: content
sub_fields.instructions: For consent fields this is the agreement text (links allowed).

fields.label: Registration status
fields.name: reg_status
fields.instructions: Automatic opens/closes by the dates below and shows "Application Full" once maximum capacity is reached. The other options override it manually.

fields.label: Minimum capacity
fields.name: capacity_min
fields.instructions: Target needed for the event to run (shown in admin).

fields.label: Waiting list when full
fields.name: enable_waitlist
fields.instructions: Keep accepting registrations as "Waitlist" after capacity is reached (Automatic mode).

fields.label: "Application Full" heading
fields.name: full_title
fields.placeholder: Thank you for your interest in {event_title}

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.name: confirmation_message
fields.instructions: Placeholders: {event_title}, {event_date}, {event_time}, {event_venue} and any field key, e.g. {fullname}.

fields.label: Recipients
fields.name: admin_emails
fields.instructions: One per line. Empty = Settings default.

fields.label: Send confirmation email to applicant
fields.name: notify_applicant
fields.instructions: Sent to the first Email field.

fields.label: Email body
fields.name: email_body
fields.instructions: Same placeholders as above, plus {registration_details} for a table of all answers.
